records.text: River Analytics still hasn't created a project a week in, flagging for outreach

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Jordan,

Great to have you. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, but if you'd rather skip ahead, the important part is just getting real work into it rather than a placeholder.

Reply here with any questions.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: 6 days post-signup with no project, no invite, no key milestone, and no reply to the welcome email [email:9405be5d]; zero tickets means no engagement signal at all. Accounts silent through the first week rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: Getting your first Wrenfield project started
draft.body:
Hi Jordan,

Checking in as you settle into Wrenfield. The simplest place to begin is a first project "" projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting one real piece of work in usually makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if you'd like a guided path.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Chidi
